I work on statistical modeling, machine learning and generative AI, in both academic and industry projects.

I enjoy connecting statistical theory to practical applications, and I enjoy teaching: my goal is to prepare professionals for the challenges of data science and to contribute to scientific and technological innovation.

## Currently

-   **Senior Data Scientist** at [XP Inc](https://www.xpi.com.br/), since 2025.
-   **Graduate lecturer** at [Insper](https://www.insper.edu.br/), since 2021, teaching statistical learning, data modeling and neural networks.

## Highlight

My PhD thesis received an **honorable mention in the Francisco Aranda-Ordaz Award** (2026), granted by SLAPEM and the Bernoulli Society to the best Latin American theses in Probability and Statistics. More on the [Research](research.qmd) page.

## Interests

Statistical learning · Inference for stochastic processes · Graphical models · Credit risk · Generative AI

## Writing and materials

-   [Materials](materials.qmd): books, lecture notes, tutorials and slides.
-   [Blog](/posts.html): posts on statistics, data science, R and AI (in Portuguese).
